Klasse NpcAppearance.Builder

java.lang.Object
dev.shvquu.betternpcs.api.npc.property.NpcAppearance.Builder
Umschließende Klasse:
NpcAppearance
public static final class NpcAppearance.Builder extends Object
Builds NpcAppearance instances.

Not thread safe; build on one thread and share the immutable result.
